summary: Iteration 43 — Avatar Teacher photo upload + super admin operations + email notifications + view backward compat tested end-to-end. Backend: 10/11 pytest pass + 1 skip (Gmail SMTP egress blocked in the container — confirmed environmental, not a code defect). Frontend: SuperAdmin sa-test-email + sa-wipe-demo buttons VISIBLE & wired; Avatar Teach tab renders all 4 presets (ada/kwame/amara/zuri) + upload-photo button + correct disabled→enabled gating + voice indicator. Start avatar teaching short-circuits on the synthetic test doc (preview_text empty) — works fine on real docs based on earlier 200 OKs from mentor/chat + advanced/tts in logs.

critical.issue: ALL outbound SMTP from the K8s pod fails with 'Connection unexpectedly closed' / 'timed out' on smtp.gmail.com:587. The /api/super-admin/test-email endpoint returns {sent:0, failed:1, total:1} and the public-content upload notification logs sent=0 failed=43 total=43. The endpoint logic itself is correct (notification fans out to all 43 active users as designed and the log line 'public-content notification sent to N recipients' appears), but the container egress for port 587 appears blocked. Action: switch to Resend HTTP API (RESEND_API_KEY is already in backend/.env) or open SMTP egress in the preview environment.

minor.issue: Endpoint signature `ids: list[str], hard: bool=False` requires `ids` as the RAW JSON body (an array) and `hard` as a QUERY param. Most JSON clients will send `{ids:[...], hard:false}` and get 422. The frontend currently does this correctly, but the contract is fragile — consider a Pydantic BulkDeleteReq model.

When preview_text is empty (e.g., very small PDFs PyPDF2 cannot parse, or media files), the avatar handler short-circuits with toast 'No text available for avatar teaching'. Consider also falling back to doc.description so the avatar can still narrate.

integration_issues.flow: Avatar narration on a fresh doc
integration_issues.issue: Synthetic doc with empty preview_text triggers an early-return toast that auto-dismisses; UI gives no permanent indicator that the doc is not avatar-teachable. The disabled-state for the Start button only checks `!avatarImage`, not text availability.

action_items: HIGH: SMTP outbound is blocked in the preview env (Gmail SMTP times out). All 'sent' counts are 0. Either switch the helper to use Resend's HTTP API (RESEND_API_KEY already configured) or arrange SMTP egress. Current code path is otherwise correct (43 recipients identified, log line emitted).
LOW: Add Pydantic model for /api/super-admin/public-content/bulk-delete to accept {ids, hard} in body uniformly.
LOW: In PublicContentViewPage handleAvatarTeach, fall back to doc.description when preview_text is empty (or disable the Start button + show 'No text to narrate' helper text).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is 14,252 lines — far over the 700-line guideline. Strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth, courses, public, super_admin, advanced, mentor, payments, etc.).

sa_upload_public_content correctly streams to disk in 1MB chunks (memory-safe), defers heavy text extraction to a background asyncio.to_thread, and broadcasts the email notification in the same background task. Upload latency for a 6MB PDF was ~1s on the preview host — well under the 5s spec.

public_view_content cleanly supports BOTH new file_path (on-disk) and legacy file_data (base64) — verified by direct curl: new uploads return 200 application/pdf with file_path; old base64 docs would also continue to work via the elif branch.

PublicContentViewPage.js avatar tab renders correct disabled state (`disabled={avatarBusy || !avatarImage}`) and the Speaking… indicator only renders when `audioPlaying && avatarImage`. UI gating is correct.

smtp_notifications.send_notification_email and broadcast_to_org both correctly use asyncio.to_thread to avoid blocking — but the underlying smtplib.SMTP(...) call has a 30s timeout which would compound if many recipients fail. Consider parallel sends (asyncio.gather).

context_for_next_testing_agent: All new testids work: sa-test-email, sa-wipe-demo, avatar-preset-ada/kwame/amara/zuri, avatar-upload-photo, avatar-face, avatar-stop-btn, learner-avatar-btn, learner-tab-avatar. Backend endpoints all return 200 for the happy path. The single material issue is SMTP egress: in this preview env, all outbound smtp.gmail.com:587 connections time out, so 'sent' is always 0 even though the broadcast logic correctly identifies recipients and writes the expected log line. The notification feature is functionally complete but undeliverable from the preview pod. Recommend switching to Resend HTTP API (RESEND_API_KEY=re_2a42c7kW... is already in backend/.env).
rca of the issue: Email notifications: send_email -> _send_email_sync -> smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST=smtp.gmail.com, SMTP_PORT=587, timeout=30) raises 'Connection unexpectedly closed' on first byte and on retries times out. Application code and recipient enumeration both work — the public-content background task correctly enqueues 43 emails and logs the broadcast attempt. Container egress on TCP 587 (or to smtp.gmail.com specifically) is the bottleneck. Fix: use the Resend REST API (POST https://api.resend.com/emails with RESEND_API_KEY) inside send_email instead of smtplib; the Resend key + SENDER_EMAIL are already in /app/backend/.env.
